name: Ghost Crystal Cloud AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
description: The xulgath corpse splits open to release a cloud of tiny ectoplasmic crystals which, when they are inhaled, disorient and devitalize living creatures.
disable: DC 26 Arcana or DC 26 Occultism (expert) to render the crystal cloud inert
reset: The crystals regrow into a number sufficient to form another dangerous cloud after 1 week.

generalAbilities.name: Ectoplasmic Explosion
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches or disturbs the corpse containing the growth of crystals

Effect All creatures within 10 feet of the corpse are exposed to the ghost crystal cloud.

generalAbilities.name: Ghost Crystal Cloud
generalAbilities.description:
Creatures with the ethereal trait are immune

Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d10 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d10 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d10 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 3 (1 round)
